nom: SUNDAY RILEY Aquamarine Melt Hydrating Gel Balm Cleanser

avis.titre: Waste of money, packaging, my time, my zen
avis.texte: Ugh. The dispenser requires you to pump it over and over and over again before it will spit out the barest amount of cleanser - and what does come out is mostly a thin oil with a few chunks of blue that left my face feeling greasy. I initially assumed it was user error - perhaps I'd left the bottle on its side? - but nope. Right side up, left alone, shaken like a martini: nothing changed the pitiful outcome. Then I thought that perhaps my bottle was defective, but a thirty second intranets search shows multiple complaints like mine. What a waste!
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] It's smells nice it's a gel cleanser so it laters differently then others but it's super nice love ittt
I really wanted to like this product. I think its a great pre-cleanse but thr packaging is awful. The pump leaks and gets oil all over the bottle and everything else. Will not purchase again.
This product is not good. It shoots out all oil and does nothing but spreads makeup around. Its supposed to be thicker but ive not seen this. Awful waste of money
This works for taking off makeup but the pump broke 3 pumps in. How do I open this pump to get the product out? This company needs to figure out packaging. Terrible. Will not buy again.

avis.titre: Packaging made it not worth it
avis.texte: I got this as a gift and from the get-go the pump was broken :( the product came out super runny and was an oily mess. I was still able to use it, but eventaully the pump got so jammed that I just had to give up. Otherwides, it did a great job removing my makeup…not sure its worth the price though

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] My wife was really amazed at how well this product works at getting makeup off. After using it her skin was left feeling very soft and clean. This will likely replace her other makeup removers.

avis.titre: Just what I was looking for
avis.texte: Smells great, works well. There is a slight oil, so I pump directly on my face - instead on my hands. Use as an initial cleanser to remove makeup, followed by a foaming cleanser, just because of the medical grade products in my regimen. Could also be used alone, makes skin feel great and very soft.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The packaging is pretty and appealing. The bottle was kind of hard to open. The actual product smelled so bad I didn't even want to try it. When I did try it, it made my face feel so awful. It was way too oily and I almost couldn't wash it off. It made my skin feel really gross and even after I washed my face again I could still smell the product. 10/10 do NOT recommend

I didn't like anything about this product. The scent is awful, it leaves a gross, greasy film on your face. I have to follow it with my normal cleanser to get the feeling off my skin. Doesn't even remove makeup that well, so you're better off buying a different product if you want to double cleanse….

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've used cream and balm cleansers, but this was my first gel cleanser. I really like that this gel cleaner is dispensed vs scooped out. It feels more sanitary and less of a hassle. I used it as the first step of my double cleansing routine and my skin looked amazing the next day. A little goes a long way and my makeup melted immediately. My only complaint ( and I've found this with ALL cleansers) is it removed most but not all of my makeup. I still needed to use a makeup wipe to fully remove everything.

avis.titre: Great, when it's the right consistency…
avis.texte: Using this product the first time I purchased it was amazing! It literally melted my makeup right off! It wasn't greasy, smells pleasant like a spa and washed off easily. I'm not sure what happened but it all of a sudden turned into an oil. When pumping the top to dispense the product, oil splashes out and gets everywhere. It becomes a giant mess! I contacted Ulta's customer service and they told me to go back into the store and exchange it. After explaining I drive 35 minutes to my closest store and I had a sick child at home, they insisted I needed to exchange it in store. After I finally made it to the store to exchange it, I got the new bottle home and was so excited to wash my face with the aquamarine gel. First pump splashes clear oil all over my sink and counter. I'm not sure what is happening to the consistency but it would be 5 stars if it stayed the original consistency. I have tried using the oil to remove my makeup but it mostly just smears the makeup around. Even after wiping with a washcloth, I still will wipe makeup on my dry towel. Idk if I would buy this again. I'm not even sure if I want to exchange it for another of the same product. Super disappointed.

This stuff is absolutely amazing! It melts the makeup right off your face and makes your face feel squeaky clean. Plus, I don't know what is about the smell, but I love the smell of all Sunday Riley products!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I'm obsessed with this cleanser! The scent is amazing. It smells like I'm at a spa every time I use it. The texture has so much slip and provides a gentle cleanse. It's super moisturizing on my dry skin. I loveeeee it!
Made my skin super soft, the texture is great. It didnt sting not even in my sensitive spots.

I received this item for free This cleanser is absolutely AMAZING! The initial feel of the balm is silky and moves around the skin beautifully! My make up came right off and face feels so soft and clean. I wasn't sure expecting to love this so much.

avis.titre: Too expensive for this terrible bottle
avis.texte: I love the smell and it's a great first cleanser. The package foaming pump got loose after a couple of uses but I was still able to use it. Today the package completely broke leaving an oily mess that is very difficult to clean. I'm upset at the waste

This gel balm cleanser is wonderful. It really breaks down any make up that is left on your face and I love the consistency of it. The sun is not too strong but I do get more of a clean scent from this, so I think it's perfect.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This was a lovely product! the packaging is a very pretty blue and the bottle is a good size. i was excited to try this, i have tried a few other sunday riley products but not their cleaners. the product itself is also a pretty blue color and it cleansed nicely, and did not burn my eyes when i used it over my mascara. unfortunately, i have very sensitive and acne prone skin, and my skin did not love this :( i ended up gifting it to my sister after using it a few times, her skin is not very sensitive, and she has loved it so far! she says she enjoys the consistency of the product and how well it takes her makeup off. i was gifted this product for my review. thank you < 3

avis.titre: Love this more than I thought I would
avis.texte: I received this product for free from influencer. This cleanser is absolutely AMAZING! The initial feel of the balm is silky and moves around the skin beautifully! My make up came right off and face feels so soft and clean. I wasn't sure expecting to love this so much.

I really like the Sunday Riley Aquamarine Melt Hydrating Gel-Balm Cleanser! The texture is super smooth and feels nice on my skin. It smells fresh and makes my face feel soft and clean. I just wish it worked a little better on heavy makeup. I received this product in exchange for my honest review for Sunday Riley.

avis.titre: Not the best oil based cleanser
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This product was decent but it did have a strange smell. It did not feel like it seeped into my pores. I have used other products that seemed to give better results in my opinion. I felt like I still needed to clean my face with another cleanser. The effectiveness of other oils based washes left my face feeling better .

I used to buy every single Sunday Riley product for years and changed to cleaner ingredients about two years ago. I wanted to try this. Im just not a fan. I feel this is unnecessarily expensive for the little that it does. It didnt even remove all of my washable mascara and it was all over my towel after I allegedly washed my face. There are chepaer alternatives that do more. The packaging is impeccable, as always, but thats not what I'm paying for.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This product doesn't have much of a smell but is extremely hydrating which I love. It takes makeup off quickly and seamlessly. However I wish it had more of a refreshing feel after washing my face. Other than that great product

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Effective cleanser for oily to combination skin. It has a pleasant scent without being overwhelming and the texture is more like a gel. It may be a bit abrasive if you have sensitive skin.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a good melting makeup remover! The packaging is nice because you don't have to dig into it and it removes makeup very well too! I also love the ingredients as well

This gel balm cleanser is definitely worth it. It takes off your makeup with ease and leaves your face feeling very hydrated as well. It comes out of the bottle as a gel, but once applied, it turns into an oil-like substance. Plus, it smells amazing. I would highly recommend this product.
It cleanses well, probably not best for people with dry or combination skin because it was drying for me. It does have a bad smell, like rubber, but it doesn't linger on skin. Has nice packaging

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Absolutely loved this cleanser! The smell was great, and it melted my makeup right off. It left my face feeling clean and smooth. Love all the great ingredients in this cleanser as well!
This is a great product! Takes off makeup well and feels quite gentle on the skin! I would consider this product to be a bit overpriced but it does work well!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I loved the way this made my face feel after using it for a while. I was surprised at the gentleness of the ingredients. The shapenof the bottle fit nicely in my hand, and the scent was pleasant.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Great cleanser, light weight on the skin and is very effective at removing makeup! I personally didn't use it for my eye area since I have sensitive eyes so I can't speak to the abilities there. I'd recommend this product!
I really recommend this product. It's great for waterproof makeup.
Smells amazing and feels luxurious on the skin! Those not into oils might skip it, but I absolutely love it! It will be a regular part of my routine.

I received this product in exchange for my honest review. Enjoyable, multi skin type mildly scented cleanser, not quite a cream, not quite a gel. Easily cleanses face without leaving a filmy feel. Only complaint is, since it's a pump, I wonder how effectively I'll be able to use ALL the product without wasting some at the bottom. All in all a good option for face cleansers.

[I received this item in exchange for my honest review] This cleansing balm was just okay, in my opinion. It didn't stand out from other cleansers I've used. While it did leave my skin feeling clean and hydrated, the scent was either slightly unpleasant or just underwhelming. I do understand that unscented products are generally better for the skin, though.
I love this product.. its so much more convenient for me in this form rather than a balm form. I recommend giving it a try! It's lovely :)

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Love this ! I have been stuck on one gel cleaner forever and this was a pleasant surprise... the packaging is easy to get into and nice looking. It left me feeling refreshed I will definitely keep this in my skin care routine going foward

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Love the way this makes my skin feel. The texture is gel like but not sticky or oily. Cleanses my skin thoroughly. The smell is pleasant, not overpowering. The packaging is really nice, pretty bottle.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This cleanser is great! It is a makeup remover but my skin felt really clean after using it, like I didn't need to double cleanse. I love the smell and how well it took off my makeup. I will continue to use this!

I loVe this gel balm cleanser. I love The scent, how it applies as a gel-balm then turns into an oil makeup remover. I love that it doesn't dry my skin out. So easy to use. I definitely think this is a must try.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review]. I have been using this cleanser for few weeks and it seems to be good at removing makeup and dirt. It leaves the skin soft and hydrated. It has a mild scent. I like using it at the end of the day.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Loved the feeling of this cleanser!! It was light but still made my face feel clean and fresh. No strong scent!! My skin felt very dewy for the entire time while getting ready. Didn't feel any residues left over.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] LOVE the creaminess, texture & scent of this cleanser! Goes on like a gel & melts into a luscious cleansing oil. Dreamy! [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The packaging of this product makes it very easy and mess free to use. The consistency is great and melts into face. The smell is nice but very strong. I have sensitive skin and the product doesn't irritate my skin, however it does leave my skin feeling oily. I noticed some breakouts and clogged pores after using this product multiple days in a row.

avis.titre: Not my everyday cleaner for sure
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Not your moms foamy cleanser for sure. It takes a second to warm up to a gel cleanser, for sure . It says that it melts away impurities and makeup but it didn't do much to remove mine, it remained to be wiped away by my towel afterwords. It is definitely a light gel consistency, hardly felt like any cleaner I've used , but I expected that for sure. The pump was sturdy and the container, a light clean blue color , and the gel itself an aqua blue color. Packaging was sturdy and presentable, colorful , but I can't say I'd identify the product inside by the outside colors . Black packaging . Smell was light and slightly sweet , aromatic, and clean .

avis.titre: gifted product but would buy again!

The scent is a little much and I would prefer it to be less strong but I've also gotten more used to it over time. I would definitely purchase this product.

I received this product from Influe nster for free in exchange for my honest review. It was well packaged and I love the blue bottle. It comes out as a gel and once applied it turns into an oil/lotion to help cleanse and hydrate. The ingredient in this product is mainly Aqua as it should be to provide the hydration. This not only cleanses but it removes makeup very easily. Definitely a must buy!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love how hydrating this cleanser is. It takes off all my makeup with ease and since you use a wet washcloth to remove it, you get some gentle exfoliation as well. The scent is very pleasant and the natural color is a beautiful light blue.

avis.titre: A long awaited solution to my dry skin
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Before Sunday Riley's Aquamarine Melt Gel-Balm Cleanser, I would run to my moisturizer after washing my face to mitigate an uncomfortable, tight, and parched feeling. Sensitive skincare didn't work. Nor did Korean nor Vanicream. I had devolved to not washing my face at all. But THIS. This wash is something I LOOK FORWARD to using. The product itself does not foam and isn't cream, but is not overly oily. It's a…fluffy oil - like if you used an immersion blender on a lip mask. I rub 2 pumps onto my dry face and remove with a soft warm washcloth. It feels like I'm leaving a tad of the oil behind - but it truly does MELT into your skin, leaving behind an adequate amount of moisture so as not to strip your skin's barrier. It leaves my skin bright and able to receive moisturizer without burning. The label encourages one to breathe in the essential oils of it - one being a hint of refreshing chamomile, not a hit-you-in-face scent of lavender, peppermint, or tea tree (ones might also irritate your delicate skin barrier). Though I am someone who could blissfully live in a bottle of essential oils, the smell of this is beautifully subtle. My one and only gripe with this is the packaging. The tapered base in combination with a loose fitting cap (and me not wearing my contacts when I wash my face), has led to me knocking this over and blurrily chasing the top as it bounces around the bathroom floor 4 out of 5 times. Definitely ca

The Sunday Riley Aquamarine Melt Hydrating Gel-Balm Cleanser was gentle, lightweight and didn't leave my skin feeling stripped or dry. The texture was interesting because it's a combination of gel and balm and it didn't have much lather or suds because of the gel-balm formula. Had a scent that is typical to Sunday Riley products, but wasn't my cup of tea. I received this product in exchange for my honest review.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a nice product to remove makeup. I used it as the first step in my double cleanse routine. It left my face moisturized and soft. It has a cupcake like smell if that bothers you.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This cleanser was effective at removing most of the gunk (sunscreen and makeup) off of my face and made for a decent first round of cleansing. [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The packaging of this product is really pretty and feels high quality. The cleanser itself is very hydrating and feels soothing on the skin, but the product is highly fragrance. If you have sensitive or acne prone skin, I would avoid it. It's not a bad product, but personally, for my skin I don't think this product is suitable.

avis.titre: I look forward to using each night

I also like the scent; it's not overpowering as I anticipated. Certainly a staple in my skincare routine now!

This is my new favorite cleanser! It took my makeup off so easily, easier than any other balm or oil cleanser i've used before! I was so impressed! And after rinsing, my skin felt so clean but not dry or stripped. It also didn't feel oily! I loved this!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've been using this cleansing balm for a couple of weeks now, and it's officially replaced every other balm in my routine! It easily melts away makeup, no harsh rubbing needed and leaves my skin feeling clean and nourished. I love the packaging as well, it's hygienic and mess-free, with no need to dip fingers into the product. avis.titre: Don't forget to apply to *dry* skin
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I learned how to properly use cold cream a couple years ago and it's my go-to when taking off waterproof make up, so I was excited to try a similar product. Similar to cold cream, it's important to apply this product to *dry* skin so that it can properly "melt" and remove make up. But, unlike the Dove cold cream I usually use, I don't always feel the need to use another cleanser after this. If this product is within your budget, I'd recommend it. Otherwise, Dove cold cream paired with your regular cleanser is a good alternative.

avis.titre: Not for me, pleasant scent, though
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The Sunday Riley Aquamarine Melt Hydrating Gel-Balm Cleanser was a no-go for me. I loved the scent of this cleanser, and it could be good when you just feel too lazy to do a good thorough face cleansing. However, for the price, I can't say this cleanser is any better than any other oil cleanser out on the market, and I feel it needs to be followed up with an actual soap cleanser. I also don't think this cleanser will work for anyone who has oily skin or combination skin. I think it caused acne breakouts on my skin as well, and I have normal skin. Therefore, I won't be using it again.

avis.titre: Very nicely packaged, effective gel cleanser.
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I received this in exchange for an honest review. This does exactly what it says, and the texture is extremely nice. It is a true-gel balm — it doesn't have that super oily texture of traditional cleansing balms, but it definitely emulsifies like a balm. Out of the container it has a creamy gel texture. I definitely need at least 2 pumps with this, and it has an earthy smell. I love the packaging, it feels much more sanitary than the balms you have to dig out with your hands, and the gel means it's less messy than an oil cleanser and less likely to lead to an inadvertent mess. I didn't notice any breakouts with this (a problem I've had with other balm cleansers) but I also didn't notice a huge benefit either. I did use this as a first step in a double cleansing routine. I still prefer other cleansing balms over this one, but I will definitely be using this up. It's nice, just maybe not nice enough to repurchase when there are others I enjoy more.
